theorems.statement: (∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ⨆ j, μs j K < ∞) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), StrictMono φ ∧ μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs (φ j))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun j => μs (φ j) K) atTop ≤ μ K) ∧ (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => μs (φ j) G) atTop)) ∧ (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Xs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U k) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ξs : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (μX μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξX : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ℝ), IsOpen U → Continuous f → WeaklyConvergesOn Xs X → (∀ j, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μs j K < ∞) → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (ξs j) (μs j)) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μs j), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξs j x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ j, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Xs j ω = ∫ x, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂(μs j)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μX K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξX μX → (∀ᵐ x ∂μX, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξX x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = ∫ x, ξX x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μX) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → μ {x | f x = t} = 0 → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξX x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μX))) ∧ (∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ) (L : NNReal) (Z : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), Continuous f → (∀ j, μs j (G ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}) < ∞) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → Z j t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μs j (G ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → liminf (fun j => Z j t) atTop ≤ g t) ∧ ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun j => μs j (G ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b})) atTop)
